name: Build the client modules from the source package for a chosen kernel

tasks.name: Install the build dependencies and the headers of the target kernel
commands: # The source package Depends list is not sufficient on its own: flex, bison and the
# Python headers are needed by configure but are not listed.

apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 install -y module-assistant build-essential bzip2 debhelper libtool libyaml-dev libnl-genl-3-dev libselinux-dev libsnmp-dev libkeyutils-dev libmount-dev mpi-default-dev pkg-config autoconf automake quilt fakeroot flex bison python3-dev libssl-dev libreadline-dev

tasks.name: Install the source package and unpack the tree
Build the binary module package for the target kernel
commands: # Optional features are off unless named in DEB_BUILD_PROFILES. flock is one of them, and a module built without it refuses a mount that asks for flock.
# module-assistant leaves the source tree and the object tree unset, so both are
# passed explicitly. kdist_config runs configure, binary-modules builds and packages.
export KVERS="${TARGET}" KSRC="${KSRC}" KSRC_TREE="${KSRC}" LINUX="${KSRC}" LINUX_OBJ="${KSRC}" DEB_BUILD_PROFILES="${BUILD_PROFILES:-flock}"
fakeroot debian/rules kdist_config > "/tmp/configure-${TARGET}.log" 2>&1 || { echo 'CONFIGURE FAILED'; tail -25 "/tmp/configure-${TARGET}.log"; exit 1; }
grep -E '^(checking for Linux sources|checking for Linux objects)' "/tmp/configure-${TARGET}.log" | head -4
fakeroot debian/rules binary-modules > "/tmp/build-${TARGET}.log" 2>&1 || { echo 'BUILD FAILED'; tail -25 "/tmp/build-${TARGET}.log"; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Compare the built package with the published one
Install the built package and load it, replacing anything already resident
commands: # The module alone is not enough: mount -t lustre needs the userspace helper from
# lustre-client-utils, otherwise the kernel receives the raw option list and refuses.
# A resident module keeps serving the old code, so everything Lustre has to come out
# first. LNet holds references until the network is taken down.
if [ "$(lsmod | grep -cE '^(lustre|lnet|libcfs)')" != "0" ]; then echo 'still resident, rebooting to load from disk'; systemd-run --on-active=5 --unit=task-runner-reboot /sbin/reboot; sleep 180; fi
echo 'the loaded module is byte-identical to the one just built'
